title: plugin-approvals: the record-lock refusal ("… is locked while an approval is in progress …") is English in every locale, against the request-locale rule (#32655)
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAjSbVCwcyoaiYadYJW

Filing gate **① a reproduced defect** (user-visible), measured from HotCRM 6.4.0 on platform **18.5.0** during the end-to-end customer test, zh-CN organization.

## What happens

A zh-CN user edits a record that an approval has locked. The refusal comes back in English, while the platform's other refusals on the same request come back in Chinese.

| Request (`Accept-Language: zh-CN`, zh-CN org) | Answer |
|---|---|
| `PATCH /api/v1/data/crm_project/<id>` while the initiation approval is pending | 409 `Project '华东仓储客服平台实施' is locked while an approval is in progress, and cannot be edited until that approval is complete` |
| `POST /api/v1/data/crm_timesheet` with a lookup to a project the caller cannot read (same session) | 400 `项目:不存在 id 为“p7Rkvm07v92Z9zmo”的crm_project记录` (localized) |

The console shows the English sentence as the toast on a record a user cannot save.

## Seam

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts:294` (`recordLockRefusal`, origin/main e71ecc1b) builds the sentence as an English template literal. The rule landed by #32655 (closed; ruling C on #32440) says user-facing refusal text is in the request locale.

## Suggestion

Translate the lock refusal through the platform's message catalogue like the other record-door refusals, keeping the object label and record title interpolated. While there, check that the locale packs carry the same sentence for the bulk-row status path (`record-lock-batch-row-status.integration.test.ts` pins the English text).

## Business reason

Every approval-locked record (large deals, project initiation, timesheets, expenses, account approval in HotCRM) answers a Chinese, Japanese or Spanish user in English at the exact moment they are blocked. The sentence is what tells them why they cannot save.

**Reader:** the objectstack server lane (plugin-approvals).

**Grade suggestion: `priority:p2`**: user-visible on every approval lock in non-English orgs. **Size: S.**

**Dedupe:** `gh api search/issues` on `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue approval lock refusal locale` (6 hits). #32655 (closed) is the rule, #25809 (closed) fixed flow-tripped validation messages, and #26883 (closed) fixed inbox labels. None covers the record-lock refusal.
